That evening he wrote a reply, sealed it in the same bottle, and cast it back into the tide, trusting the sea to carry one more small hope somewhere worth arriving.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还在沉睡。街灯把空旷的马路照成一条安静的河，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，留下一声轻响。便利店的玻璃亮着，收银员靠在柜台边打盹。远处高楼的窗口大多熄灭，只有零星几盏还亮着，像没合上的眼睛。清洁工推着车走过，扫帚划过地面。天边泛起一丝灰蓝，鸟还没有醒，风带着凉意。这是城市最温柔也最孤独的时刻，属于那些尚未入睡和即将醒来的人。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of the same problem.\n• You keep breaking it into smaller pieces until a piece is so tiny it's easy to answer directly.\n• Like standing between two mirrors: each reflection contains another, smaller reflection, all the way down."}
